What should I do if the tracking never updates?
If your tracking never updates, you can:
For online orders with us: use Track My Order here: https://trackmyorder.petloverscentre.com/TrackOrder.aspx.
For in-store delivery: wait for the WhatsApp tracking on delivery day; if you never got a delivery-date confirmation, contact our Home Delivery Team via the online contact form.
For Lazada, Shopee, FairPrice, GrabMart or FoodPanda orders: track directly in their apps and, if needed, use their in-app Help Centre/Contact Us options.
If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.
